description: This file defines a React component 'ProfilePage' that displays user profile information along with their posts, including real-time updates via supabase subscriptions. It manages state and effects related to fetching profile and post data and rendering it accordingly.

methods.name: ProfilePage()
methods.description: React functional component rendering user profile info and posts with real-time updates.

calls: supabase.from('posts').select('id, content, created_at, user_id, profiles!inner(username), like_count, comment_count, status').eq('user_id', id).eq('status', 'approved').order('created_at', { ascending: false })
